opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship (2027)

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship includes a financial incentive of £1000, to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Aimed at young people aged 18-24; open to applicants from the UK with a demonstrable interest in the relevant study tour (dairy and pig for 2027).
opportunities.summary: An initiative to develop young talent in the farming industry. A 30-day study programme (June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, fully funded including all travel and subsistence, attendance at the Nuffield Conference, and Nuffield Farming Associate membership. For 2027 the Trust plans to award three dairy and three pig scholarships.
